title: Worker hangs on SIGTERM while a job is running
author: hollis
body: Sending SIGTERM to a busy Worker never exits; the job finishes but the process stays up.

title: schedule() ignores the tz argument
author: sam-okafor
body: schedule(at=..., tz='Europe/Berlin') runs the job at UTC time.

title: Add Queue.drain() to wait until all jobs finish
author: tobiaslund
body: Useful in tests and graceful shutdowns.

title: Memory leak in the result cache
author: ana-p
body: Results are kept forever when result_ttl is unset. Fix landed in two commits (one cherry-picked).

title: retry_backoff option on Worker
author: lena-ortiz
body: Exponential backoff between retries, off by default.

title: Job.retries is off by one
author: sam-okafor
body: A job with retries=3 runs four times.

title: Drop support for Python 3.9
author: lena-ortiz
body: Python 3.9 is end of life. Minimum is now Python 3.10.

title: RedisBackend does not release the connection after a timeout
author: rvdb
body: Pool exhaustion after many timeouts.

title: Prometheus metrics endpoint
author: ana-p
body: New metrics_server() helper serves queue depth, job durations and failures.

title: Add Queue.peek_many()
author: dkowal
body: Look at the next n jobs without taking them.

title: Rename Queue.put_nowait() to Queue.try_put()
author: lena-ortiz
body: put_nowait() suggested asyncio semantics it never had. try_put() returns False when full instead of blocking.

title: Queue.stats() dashboard
author: sam-okafor
body: Work in progress behind a flag.

title: Deprecate Queue.size in favour of len(queue)
author: sam-okafor
body: Queue.size still works and warns; removal planned for 3.0.

title: Job.cancel() for queued jobs
author: lena-ortiz
body: Cancels a job that has not started yet.

title: Refactor the backend registry
author: lena-ortiz
body: No user-facing change.

title: Redis Sentinel support in RedisBackend
author: dkowal
body: Pass sentinels=[...] to connect through Redis Sentinel.

title: Queue.try_put() raises ValueError instead of QueueFull
author: rvdb
body: Introduced by #418, which has not been released yet.

title: Pickle payloads deserialized without an allow-list (CVE-0000-00000)
author: mira-k
body: A crafted job payload could run code on the worker. Fixed by the new serializer_allowlist option, on by default.

title: Fix typo in README
author: hollis
body: 'recieve' -> 'receive'.

title: Move CI to ubuntu-24.04
author: sam-okafor
body: Runner image update.

title: Worker logs every poll at DEBUG
author: rvdb
body: Too noisy. The fix is merged to main and scheduled for 2.5.0.

title: Async Queue API
author: ana-p
body: Design discussion.
